accepted.s: The National Health Mission (NHM) presently consists of which of the following two sub-missions?
accepted.x: NHM has two sub-missions: the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
accepted.tq: Identify the exact composition of the mission rather than confusing its schemes with its sub-missions.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s:
With reference to ASHA workers, consider the following statements:
1. ASHA stands for Accredited Social Health Activist.
2. ASHA functions as a link between households and the health system.
3. ASHA is a village-level community health worker.
4. ASHA and ANM are regarded as important components of rural healthcare delivery.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. ASHA means Accredited Social Health Activist, and ASHAs and ANMs play a crucial role in linking rural communities with healthcare services.
accepted.tq: Use the expansion, function, level of operation and institutional role as separate statement checks.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: According to the India Year Book 2026, the number of ASHAs in Andhra Pradesh is approximately:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has 42,060 ASHAs according to the cited India Year Book 2026 figure.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact numerical value from nearby figures.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)?
o: It provides adolescent counselling through peer educators only.
It provides cash assistance to pregnant women for institutional delivery.
It provides weekly audio messages to mothers and children.
It provides free generic medicines through public facilities.
accepted.x: JSY provides cash assistance to pregnant women to promote institutional delivery. It is a 100 per cent centrally sponsored scheme.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its principal intervention and avoid swapping it with neighbouring NHM programmes.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding JSY is correct?
1. It is 100 per cent centrally sponsored.
2. Andhra Pradesh recorded 1,76,966 beneficiaries during April–December 2024.
3. Its principal focus is cash assistance for institutional delivery.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. JSY is fully centrally sponsored, promotes institutional delivery through cash assistance, and recorded 1,76,966 beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh during the stated period.
accepted.tq: Check the funding pattern, state-specific figure and core objective independently.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: The Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK) primarily covers which age group?
accepted.x: RKSK is directed towards adolescents in the 10–19 years age group.
accepted.tq: Use the age-range distinction to separate RKSK from child and adult health programmes.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT associated with the Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram?
o: Integrated Public Health Laboratories in every district
accepted.x: Integrated Public Health Laboratories in every district are associated with PM-ABHIM, not RKSK. RKSK includes adolescent clinics, peer educators, menstrual hygiene and weekly iron-folic acid supplementation.
accepted.tq: Find the item belonging to a different health mission rather than selecting a related adolescent intervention.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: Anaemia Mukt Bharat was launched in which year?
accepted.x: Anaemia Mukt Bharat was launched in 2018.
accepted.tq: Test the programme year directly using close neighbouring years as distractors.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: The ‘6x6x6’ strategy is associated with which of the following programmes?
accepted.x: Anaemia Mukt Bharat follows the 6x6x6 strategy, including IFA supplementation, deworming, testing and treatment, fortified foods and behaviour change.
accepted.tq: Recognise the distinctive numerical branding of a programme.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes Kilkari and Mobile Academy?
1. Kilkari provides 72 free weekly audio messages from the second trimester until the child turns one.
2. Kilkari operates in 27 States/Union Territories.
3. Mobile Academy is an audio course intended for ASHAs.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kilkari delivers 72 weekly audio messages over the stated period, while Mobile Academy provides an audio course for ASHAs.
accepted.tq: Separate the beneficiary, duration and function of two similarly named digital health initiatives.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct description of the Free Drugs Service Initiative?
o: Free generic medicines at public facilities, with DVDMS managing drug supply
Free vaccination records through U-WIN, managed by NHA
Free teleconsultations through Mobile Academy, managed by NIC
Free cash transfers for institutional deliveries, managed by ASHA workers
accepted.x: The Free Drugs Service Initiative provides generic medicines free of cost at public facilities, and DVDMS manages the drug supply chain.
accepted.tq: Match the service, delivery point and management system precisely.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: The usual Centre–State funding pattern under the National Health Mission is:
o: 60:40, with 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
accepted.x: The normal funding pattern is 60:40 between the Centre and States, while North-Eastern and Himalayan States receive a 90:10 pattern.
accepted.tq: Compare the general funding ratio with the special ratio for specified regions.
accepted.sec: National Health Mission - NRHM, ASHA, JSY, JSSK, RKSK, Anaemia Mukt Bharat, funding

accepted.s: Mission Indradhanush is best described as a catch-up drive under the Universal Immunisation Programme intended primarily to reach:
o: Only pregnant women in urban areas
accepted.x: Mission Indradhanush is a catch-up immunisation drive for zero-dose and partly immunised children under the Universal Immunisation Programme.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group from the programme’s operational purpose.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s: Mission Indradhanush, launched in December 2014, set a target of achieving approximately what level of full immunisation?
accepted.x: Mission Indradhanush targeted 90 per cent full immunisation coverage.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the stated coverage target from absolute or lower percentage claims.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s: Which one of the following sets of vaccines is administered at birth under the Universal Immunisation Programme?
o: BCG, OPV-0 and Hepatitis B birth dose
MR-2, DPT booster-1 and OPV booster
Td, DPT booster-2 and Rotavirus vaccine
accepted.x: The birth schedule includes BCG, OPV-0 and the birth dose of Hepatitis B.
accepted.tq: Start with the age column and eliminate vaccines belonging to later schedules.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. 9–12 months — MR-1
2. 9–12 months — JE-1 in endemic districts
3. 16–24 months — MR-2
4. 5–6 years — DPT booster-2
Which of the pairs given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. MR-1, JE-1, MR-2 and the second DPT booster occur in the stated age ranges.
accepted.tq: Verify each age–vaccine pair independently rather than relying on the sequence alone.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s: Which one of the following vaccine–age pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: DPT booster-2 is administered at 5–6 years, not at 6 weeks. The other pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the deliberately shifted age in a vaccine schedule by checking the chronological sequence.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s: The U-WIN platform is intended to digitise which of the following records?
o: Only the list of generic medicines
accepted.x: U-WIN digitises maternal and child vaccination records and supports immunisation tracking.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the vaccination-record platform from broader digital health registries.
accepted.sec: Mission Indradhanush and the immunisation schedule

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is correct?
1. It was launched in September 2021.
2. It is implemented by the National Health Authority.
3. It seeks to create a consent-based and interoperable digital health ecosystem.
4. It is built on Digital Public Infrastructure.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. ABDM was launched in September 2021, is run by NHA, and builds a consent-based interoperable ecosystem on Digital Public Infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Combine date, implementing authority, design principle and technological foundation.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the four principal registries of ABDM?
accepted.x: The four registries are ABHA, Healthcare Professionals Registry, Health Facility Registry and Drug Registry. Arogya Mitra is not an ABDM component.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘not part of the architecture’ trap to distinguish a familiar health term from an official registry.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s:
Which of the following combinations contains only gateways or enabling components associated with ABDM?
1. Health Information Consent Manager
2. Unified Health Interface
3. National Health Claim Exchange
4. Sandbox
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Health Information Consent Manager, UHI, NHCX and the ABDM Sandbox are all associated with the ABDM digital architecture.
accepted.tq: Test the complete list by separating registries from gateways and development environments.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s: As reported in June 2026, the number of ABHA accounts had crossed:
accepted.x: The reported figure was more than 90 crore ABHA accounts in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the scale of the reported figure and distinguish crore-level alternatives.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s: The March 2026 direction of the National Medical Commission required medical colleges to generate and link ABHA IDs for:
o: All OPD, IPD and emergency patients
accepted.x: The NMC directed medical colleges to generate and link ABHA IDs for all OPD, IPD and emergency patients, partly to detect fake patients during inspections.
accepted.tq: Identify the complete beneficiary category rather than narrowing the order to one department or scheme.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements is correct?
1. eSanjeevani has a Clinical Decision Support System.
2. NIC’s NextGen eHospital HMIS is ABDM-aligned.
3. AYUSH HMIS was linked to ABHA in 2024.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. eSanjeevani incorporates a Clinical Decision Support System, NextGen eHospital is ABDM-aligned, and AYUSH HMIS was linked to ABHA in 2024.
accepted.tq: Check the platform, alignment and linkage facts separately within the digital-health cluster.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM components, U-WIN, eSanjeevani, telehealth

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly matches an Ayushman Bharat pillar with its principal role?
o: Ayushman Arogya Mandir — comprehensive primary care
ABDM — construction of BSL-3 laboratories only
PM-ABHIM — cash assistance for institutional delivery
accepted.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs provide comprehensive primary care. PM-JAY is the hospitalisation assurance pillar, ABDM is the digital backbone, and PM-ABHIM strengthens health infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Match each pillar with its central role and reject cross-swapped functions.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s: The target under Ayushman Arogya Mandirs was to convert approximately how many centres?
accepted.x: The target was to convert 1,50,000 centres into Ayushman Arogya Mandirs; more than 1.73 lakh had been converted according to the cited update.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the original target from the later achievement figure.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s: Primary care delivered through Ayushman Arogya Mandirs is intended to meet approximately what proportion of healthcare needs?
accepted.x: Primary care through Ayushman Arogya Mandirs is intended to meet approximately 80–90 per cent of healthcare needs.
accepted.tq: Test the comparative coverage estimate using the stated range rather than an exact single percentage.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT listed among the services of Ayushman Arogya Mandirs?
o: Issue of passports and other civil documents
accepted.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs provide services including non-communicable disease screening, mental health, ENT, eye, oral, geriatric, palliative and trauma care. Civil-document issuance is unrelated.
accepted.tq: Identify the unrelated administrative function among a list of health services.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about PM-ABHIM is correct?
1. It focuses on health infrastructure for pandemics.
2. It was launched on 25 October 2021 at Varanasi.
3. Its approved outlay was ₹64,180 crore for FY 2021–22 to FY 2025–26.
4. It includes critical care blocks, Integrated Public Health Laboratories and BSL-3 laboratories.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. PM-ABHIM strengthens pandemic-related health infrastructure through the stated investments and facilities.
accepted.tq: Combine launch details, financial outlay, purpose and infrastructure components in one coded question.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s: In July 2022, the World Bank approved a loan of what amount for PM-ABHIM?
accepted.x: The World Bank approved a US$1 billion loan for PM-ABHIM in July 2022.
accepted.tq: Recall the institution, month and exact scale of the financial support.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover

accepted.s: The ‘Ayushman Sabhas’, weekly ‘Ayushman Melas’ and ‘Ayushman Gram’ initiatives are associated with:
accepted.x: These campaigns are associated with Ayushman Arogya Mandirs and aim to increase community participation and saturation of health-related services.
accepted.tq: Match the campaign names with the correct Ayushman Bharat pillar.
accepted.sec: Ayushman Bharat - pillars, PM-ABHIM, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, insurance cover
